name: HUMKIN · MUTANT POP
description: Free-to-listen music discovery, player embeds, and human sharing from HUMKIN.

embed_parameters.track: 1-based track number 1-12, for a single song
embed_parameters.mix: three unique 1-based track numbers, zero-padded, period-separated (e.g. 01.05.09)

permissions.embedding: Use the official HUMKIN iframe player on your webpage without modification.
permissions.personal_download: Available from the official site as web-optimized MP3s.
permissions.synchronization: Ask for permission before putting recordings into videos, games, podcasts, or films.
permissions.redistribution: No blanket permission to rehost, repackage, or sublicense the audio.
permissions.commercial_public_performance: May require additional rights/venue permissions; contact us before treating any soundtrack as business-licensed.

analytics: No application-level visitor analytics or client-side tracking code.
status: Static discovery/embedding: live when deployed; public adoptions and downstream usage are not independently tracked or verified.
